title: MidTool: Mid-training Data Synthesis for Agentic Tool Use
title_zh: MidTool：面向智能体工具使用的中期训练数据合成
abstract_en: Mid-training is increasingly recognized as a critical stage for shaping the capabilities of large language models. Recent work has shown that targeted mid-training can strengthen reasoning-intensive abilities such as math and science, and can also improve agentic capabilities in software-engineering settings. In this work, we study the parallel but less explored agentic capability: general tool use. We present MidTool, an open corpus construction pipeline for agentic tool-use mid-training that combines large-scale web, PDF, and code data with synthesized supervision from real-world tool APIs, MCP skills, and document-grounded workflows. MidTool is designed to teach models how to recognize tool affordances, ground arguments from context, compose tool call workflow, and recover from incomplete information. We mid-train Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base on MidTool-Mix, and then apply follow-up post-training with both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Compared with baselines, MidTool-Mix consistently improves downstream performance under both SFT and RL on BFCL, tau2-Bench, and MCP Universe. These results suggest that general tool use, like other important LLM capabilities, benefits from dedicated mid-training rather than being left entirely to post-training.
abstract_zh: 中期训练（mid-training）正逐渐被视为塑造大语言模型能力的关键阶段。已有研究表明，针对性的中期训练可以增强数学、科学等推理密集型能力，并改善软件工程场景中的智能体能力。本文研究一个与之对应但较少受到关注的方向：通用工具使用。作者提出 MidTool，一套面向智能体工具使用中期训练的开放语料构建流水线。该方法结合大规模网页、PDF 和代码数据，以及来自真实工具 API、MCP skills 和基于文档工作流的合成监督数据，旨在教会模型识别工具可供性、从上下文中确定调用参数、组合工具调用工作流，并在信息不完整时进行恢复。作者使用 MidTool-Mix 对 Qwen3-4B-Base 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 进行中期训练，随后通过监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）完成后训练。实验显示，相较于基线方法，MidTool-Mix 在 SFT 和 RL 两种设置下均能稳定提升模型在 BFCL、tau2-Bench 和 MCP Universe 上的表现。结果说明，与其他重要的大语言模型能力类似，通用工具使用也能从专门的中期训练中获益，而不应完全依赖后训练阶段。
key_points_zh: 提出 MidTool：面向智能体通用工具使用的开放中期训练语料构建流水线。
MidTool-Mix 融合网页、PDF、代码及真实工具 API、MCP skills 和文档工作流生成的合成监督数据。
训练目标覆盖工具可供性识别、上下文参数落地、多工具调用流程组合，以及信息缺失时的恢复能力。
在 Qwen3-4B-Base 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上先进行中期训练，再结合 SFT 与 RL 后训练。
在 BFCL、tau2-Bench 和 MCP Universe 上均稳定优于基线，验证了专门开展工具使用中期训练的价值。

llm_assessment.comment: MidTool contributes a broadly reusable synthesis pipeline and training corpus for grounding, composing, and recovering tool-use workflows across agent environments.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: MidTool提供了可广泛复用的数据合成管线与训练语料，用于学习跨环境的工具理解、工作流组合和错误恢复。
